CustomField.description: How the buyer said they would pay. Card orders are charged through Stripe and become a Transaction__c; Check orders are not charged at all and have no payment record until somebody banks the check. It is a real field rather than a key in Custom__c because a rollup cannot filter on JSON, and the Check Redemptions rollup has to count exactly these.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Card means it went to Stripe. Check means we are waiting on a check in the post.
CustomField.label: Payment Method
